false_cognates.why: link-termination-point vs tunnel-termination-point: same '-termination-point' shape, but a link end vs a trail head; different reference entries.
signal-grade vs service-grade: both carry 'grade', but an optical signal quality vs a commercial service class; both are in fact residual.
protection-group vs protection-role: both carry 'protection', but a 1+1 group vs a working/protect role; t.pgroup's true partner is i.pgroup.
